content.title: Public Art
content.summary: The City of Arvada manages a diverse collection of public art, with the Arvada Arts and Culture Commission responsible for its cataloging and maintenance, as well as exploring ways to expand the collection. Notable projects include the Short Story Dispenser, which offers free contemporary stories to the public, and the LandMark Environmental Art Exhibit, featuring works by local artists that promote community and environmental awareness, on display until April 22, 2024.
content.body:
![Mural painted on a wall showing a female face and a tiger in shades of black, white, pink and green](/ImageRepository/Document?documentId=5001)

The City of Arvada owns hundreds of pieces of art. One of the main responsibilities of the [Arvada Arts and Culture Commission](/488) is to catalog and maintain these pieces so that they may be enjoyed long into the future. The Commission will also be exploring ways to expand the City's collection of public art.

## Arvada Public Art Map

Use the interactive public art map to learn more about the City of Arvada's collection of public art. View the map below or in a [separate window](https://arcg.is/1fjqOe).

## Other public art projects in Arvada

### Short Story Dispenser

The Arvada Arts and Culture Commission's Short Story Dispenser is a fun way to revive the art of storytelling around the community. [Short Story Dispensers](https://short-edition.com/en/p/short-story-dispenser) are free-standing kiosks that publish contemporary short stories to the public for free with the touch of a button.

[**Participate in Arvada's 150/250 Short Story Contest!**](/1536)

The way it works is simple: Visitors select their preferred length of story – either 1, 3 or 5 minutes – then in a matter of seconds the dispenser prints the story from the kiosk for the visitor to enjoy.

Arvada's Short Story Dispenser travels to different locations throughout the city for three months at a time. Hosting the dispenser is free. [Learn more about Arvada's Short Story Dispenser from this story by 9News](https://youtu.be/URqv3VWxEig?feature=shared).

**Interested in hosting the Short Story Dispenser? Please [email Adelle Burton](/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#86e7e4f3f4f2e9e8c6e7f4f0e7e2e7a8e9f4e1).****![Short Story Dispenser at a coffee shop](/ImageRepository/Document?documentId=5023)**

### LandMark Environmental Art Exhibit

This outdoor exhibition featured the work of 14 accomplished regional and local Colorado artists. Each public artwork addressed the environment or sense of place. In a time that is marked by widespread isolation, these works were a direct connection between artists and people, fostering a sense of discovery, community, and environmental awareness.

The [Land Mark Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/landmarkexhibit/?hl=en) page has more information. Share your visit online using #landmarkexhibit. This exhibit was a temporary, public outdoor exhibition curated by Kalliopi Monoyios and Anna Kaye on view through April 22, 2024. Some pieces have been donated to the City of Arvada and are still on display.
